_comment: Single source of truth for upstream codec sources. Read by CMake (cmake/CodecVersions.cmake) and by tools/sync-codecs.py. snappy is first-party (src/algorithms/snappy/core) — there is no upstream to pin, so it is not a codec entry here. google/snappy (C++) is snapshotted at third_party/snappy-oracle (from tag 1.2.2) as a TEST-ONLY differential oracle — it never ships, so it is intentionally not a codec entry either.
